sections.title: Attendance
sections.instruction: Who attended, in what capacity, and the purpose of the meeting.

sections.title: Client's account
sections.instruction: The facts as the client described them, with dates, amounts and names. Mark second-hand information and anything the client is unsure of.

sections.title: Documents and evidence
sections.instruction: Documents and witnesses the client has, lacks, or will provide.

sections.title: Client's objectives
sections.instruction: What the client wants to achieve, in their order of priority.

sections.title: Advice given
sections.instruction: Only advice the solicitor actually gave, including caveats and time limits with exact dates. Do not record suggestions the solicitor rejected as advice.

sections.title: Next steps
sections.instruction: Each action with its owner and deadline where stated.
